newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police seize heroin worth $16 million.
newsitem.headline: Italian police seize heroin worth $16 million.

text.p: Italian police said on Monday they had seized over 40 kg (80 lbs) of heroin with a street value of some $16 million and arrested a man of Turkish origin.
Milan finance police said they arrested the man in his hotel bedroom in Brescia, 100 km (60 miles) east of Milan, on Saturday night and found the heroin in his car parked outside.
Police said in a statement that the seizure, part of a combined police force "Operation Ice", was one of the biggest in the northern Italian province of Lombardy.
They said the Turkish-born 29-year-old man had Italian citizenship and lived in Switzerland.
